skills.description: Generate and deploy interactive single-file HTML schedule/Gantt boards for retail store construction & opening projects (e.g. Dreame/MOVA Europe stores: Zurich / Rome / Düsseldorf) sourced from a Feishu "Timeline By" sheet. Use when: (1) building or REFRESHING an interactive store plan board (横道图/甘特图/进度看板) with a responsible-person column; (2) the user wants a self-contained HTML board with editable nodes, cascade (what-if) recalculation, stage filters, KPI cards and an opening milestone; (3) deploying the board to a shareable link. Covers fetching Feishu formulas, recomputing the model via a fixpoint cascade, parsing the Person column, rendering the SVG Gantt with a right-side 责任人 panel, and publish with known gotchas.
skills.description_zh:
用途：把飞书「Timeline By」进度表一键转换为自包含的交互式 HTML 看板（横道图/甘特图），用于门店装修与开业计划的可视化跟踪，无需手动维护图表。
适用场景
零售门店开店进度管理
需要可编辑节点、情景预设（what-if 推演）、阶段筛选、KPI 卡片、开业里程碑
想在看板右侧直接看到每项任务的「责任人」
使用示例
"生成 / 刷新 XX 店互动计划看板"
"把飞书 Timeline 做成横道图，并加上责任人列"
"部署看板到云端，生成一个可分享的链接"
技能自动完成：拉取飞书公式 → fixpoint 级联重算排期 → 解析责任人列 → 渲染 SVG 横道图（含责任人面板）→ 部署到 CloudStudio / 任意静态托管。
